name: adx_trend_macro_regime_cross_up_xrp_ada_link
rationale: Mid-cap alts (XRP, ADA, LINK) trend hardest right as the macro_regime composite TURNS risk-on, not just while it sits high. Because the composite can drift, we use cross_up to mark the regime transition, then gate on ADX above a strength floor to confirm a genuine trend rather than a one-day pop. Disconfirmer: a control run removes the macro_regime cross_up gate — if ADX-floor trades earn the same when there is no regime turn, the macro transition is not the source of edge and this is trend-following. We treat the composite as drifting and use ONLY cross_up on it.
catalyst: macro_regime composite crosses up (regime turning risk-on) while ADX is above its strength floor
